- `../objectui` `e2e/sidebar-text-visibility.spec.ts:27` stale comment (separate repo, trivial).

The 'fix broken/misleading current docs' goal is essentially complete; closing-eligible once you decide on the optional UPGRADE guide.

Done — #2399 merged. deployment-vercel.mdx MSW Mode fully removed (Hono is the only documented path); implementation-status QA table column → @objectstack/verify. content/docs/** now has zero removed-package refs. **10→11 docs alignment complete** across #2393 (internal docs) · #2396 (upgrade guide + README + 11.1.0 re-level) · #2398 (docs site) · #2399 (tail).
